title: Royalty reports. Ready for review.
headline:
Royalty reports.
Ready for review.
description: A bold two-line headline leads beside an invoice and receipt flowing through review into a finished report.
prompt:
Create ONE finished full-bleed blog thumbnail, landscape 16:9, approximately 1672×941 or higher resolution. Use the supplied image only as a style and palette reference: simple crisp slightly handmade dark-forest outlines around flat ivory paper/diagram shapes, layered directly over a finely grainy luminous gradient. Invent the requested NEW subject and layout; do not reproduce the reference diagram or its wording. This must be flat editorial art, not photoreal, 3D, glass, a UI screenshot, dashboard or mockup. The exact headline specified below must be clearly readable and lead the composition. Keep all lettering within a 6% safe margin. No overlap between headline and illustration. No logos, watermark, extra words, labels, invented financial figures or body text. Illustration cards may contain a few simple nonverbal marks, never small writing or numbers. Background: saturated sky blue #007EBD/#168DDD on the LEFT and top, softly blending to vivid lime #D6FF62 at the lower-RIGHT with subtle even fine grain. Typography: large bold sentence-case grotesk similar to DM Sans Bold, warm ivory #F8FAF5, arranged on the LEFT on exactly two lines:
Royalty reports.
Ready for review.
Fit these two lines into the left 52 percent with strong scale and clear space around them. On the RIGHT create a compact new diagram: one ivory invoice-shaped sheet with a few nonverbal rows and one narrow ivory receipt with a slightly zigzag lower edge converge through two clean forest arrows into one small circular lime review checkpoint containing a simple forest check, then one arrow leads to a slightly larger ivory report sheet. The foreground drawing has thin deep-forest #132B26 handmade outlines and flat fills, crisp and immediately readable. Put the small diagram around the middle-right, balanced with the type. No enclosing panel, no illustration labels.
